steps.title: Welcome to Omarchy
steps.screen: Let's make sure you're online and up to date. Then, if you like, a hands-on tour of the keys.
steps.done_when: The user starts the tutorial or closes the welcome screen.

steps.title: Meet the Super key
steps.screen: This is the Super key: the one with the Windows logo, or ⌘ on a Mac keyboard, between Ctrl and Alt. Almost every shortcut I'll show you starts with it. Give it a press.
steps.done_when: The app sees the key press while focused.

steps.title: Open the Omarchy menu
steps.screen: Almost everything lives in this menu. Whenever you're lost, start here.

steps.title: Launch and tile two apps
steps.screen: Omarchy puts windows side by side for you. Open two and watch them tile behind me.
steps.done_when: A terminal and a browser are open on the same workspace and focus has moved once.

subtasks.label: Move focus to the other window

steps.title: Close, float and full screen
steps.screen: Any window can float above the others, fill the screen, or close. Let's try all three.

subtasks.label: Float a window, then tile it again

steps.title: Workspaces
steps.screen: See the numbers in the bar? Each one is a workspace: a separate desktop.
steps.done_when: A workspace switch and a move-to-workspace are seen.

steps.title: Copy and paste the Omarchy way
steps.screen: Copy, paste and cut work the same way everywhere, even in the terminal. Copy the line in the terminal I opened, then paste it below.
steps.done_when: The field contains the expected text.

subtasks.label: Select the line in the terminal and copy it
Click the field below and paste

steps.title: Find any shortcut
steps.screen: You don't have to remember any of this. Every shortcut is in one list, any time.
steps.done_when: The bindings list was opened and closed.

subtasks.label: Open the list of every shortcut

steps.title: Pick a theme
steps.screen: Pick a theme and the whole desktop changes with it, me included. Keeping yours is fine too.
steps.done_when: A theme is applied, or the user keeps theirs.

steps.title: Display and comfort
steps.screen: Let's make sure text is a comfortable size. Then try the night light.
steps.done_when: The user confirms it looks right.

subtasks.label: Turn on the night light, then off again

steps.title: Your everyday apps
steps.screen: Each of your everyday apps has its own shortcut. Pick one to try.

steps.title: You're ready
steps.screen: That's the tour! These two are all you need to remember. Run omarchy onboarding to see me again, or omarchy onboarding --step <name> for one lesson.

link.text: Want to go deeper? The Omarchy manual covers everything, and it's in the menu under Learn too.
link.label: Open the manual
